accent.label: Accent color
accent.info: Overrides the preset's accent color independently of light/dark.

background.label: Background color
background.info: Leave empty to use the preset. Pairs with Text color.

text.label: Text color
text.info: Leave empty to use the preset. Text on the background and surface colors.

surface.label: Surface color
surface.info: Leave empty to use the preset. Cards, panels and drawers. Pairs with Text color.

button.label: Button color
button.info: Leave empty to use the preset. Primary button background. Pairs with Button text color.

button_text.label: Button text color
button_text.info: Leave empty to use the preset. Text on primary buttons.

scheme_toggle.label: Show light/dark toggle in header
scheme_toggle.info: Lets visitors switch between Dark and Daylight. Their choice is remembered in their browser; the preset above stays the default.

language_toggle.label: Show language toggle in header
language_toggle.info: Appears only when the store has more than one published language (Settings > Languages).

font_display.label: Display font
font_display.info: Used for headlines and tracked-out labels.

font_editorial.label: Editorial font
font_editorial.info: Used for pull-quotes and editorial accents. An italic serif is recommended.

show_sticky_atc_mobile.label: Show sticky add-to-cart bar on mobile

favicon.label: Favicon image
favicon.info: Displayed as the browser tab icon. Recommended: square image, at least 32 x 32px.

supporting_text.default: Stories from the people who use our products.
